narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The circle is seven centimetres across, so the point is only three and a half centimetres from D.
<bookmark mark='across'/>The compass opening is the radius, the distance from the centre to the circle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It is not the width. Across the whole circle is twice as much, fourteen centimetres.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Every point of a circle is the same distance from its centre, and that distance is the radius.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A circle has centre P and radius nine centimetres, and it meets a line at X. How far is X from P?
